description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTerminationAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing employee termination records within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting termination records, and implements validation rules, API documentation annotations, and interaction with underlying service and data layers.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPI
classes.description: A class providing RESTful API endpoints for handling employee termination records, including CRUD operations with validation and SDK documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee termination record by ID for a given employee number, and returns the data in a standardized resource format.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee termination record for a specified employee, setting termination details based on request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee termination record identified by ID, with data supplied in the request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the employee termination record associated with a specified employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single termination record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating that the 'getAll' method is not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a termination record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a termination record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting a termination record.
